hook: What if the Velvet Underground became the biggest band in history?

sections.voiceover: What if the Velvet Underground became the biggest band in history?
sections.visual_cue: Close up of an old vinyl record spinning on a turntable.

sections.voiceover: Klosterman’s 14th book, Rock*, presents an alternate history where music culture shifts in a new direction. What if the public spurns Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band, leaving The Beatles behind?
sections.visual_cue: Animated timeline showing the book cover next to a record sleeve.

sections.voiceover: Except the Velvet Underground's 1967 debut album actually becomes the global bestseller.
sections.visual_cue: Graphic of a 1967 calendar date highlighting the debut release.

sections.voiceover: Klosterman writes that The Velvet Underground & Nico supplants The Beatles in total cultural influence. The Velvet Underground & Nico becomes the biggest-selling record in history during this 1967 timeline.
sections.visual_cue: Split screen comparing a Beatles album cover and the Velvet Underground debut.

sections.voiceover: This fictional version of The Velvet Underground & Nico outsells every other record in music history.
sections.visual_cue: The book title Rock* appearing on a dark, textured background.
